name: comprobantepy
description: Recepción, extracción, validación y exportación de comprobantes a Marangatu

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @comprobantepy/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm run build -w @comprobantepy/shared -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @comprobantepy/api" "npm run worker -w @comprobantepy/api" "npm run dev -w @comprobantepy/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @comprobantepy/shared && npm run build -w @comprobantepy/web && npm run build -w @comprobantepy/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @comprobantepy/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @comprobantepy/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @comprobantepy/shared && npm run db:migrate -w @comprobantepy/api
